title: Who approved which email remediation, now that Advanced Hunting carries it
purpose: MC1478005 adds an ApproverUpn column to EmailPostDeliveryEvents, GA worldwide and enabled by default. Approval was previously a click-through in Action Center, one action at a time. As a column it becomes a pattern you can look at: who approves, how much, and when.

title: Remediations approved outside working hours
purpose: The same column, asked the other way. An approval at 03:00 is not wrong, but it is worth knowing about, and until now the only way to see it was to open Action Center entries one by one.

title: Linux endpoints that cannot reach the Defender configuration URL
purpose: MC1388718, reissued on 23 September as a reminder, names one configuration URL per tenant type. A Linux device that cannot reach its URL looks healthy and silently misses critical-issue mitigations. This looks for the connection attempts rather than for a health flag, because the health flag is what

title: Groups that grant an Entra role, and the password resets against their members
purpose: Microsoft corrected the Privileged Identity Management for Groups article on 22 September: credential protection covers eligible members and owners, and it exists only on groups created role-assignable. A group that grants a role without that flag leaves its eligible members resettable by a Helpdesk

title: First grant of any of the eight Graph permissions that became grantable on 22 September
purpose: Six permission families entered the Microsoft Graph service principal between the 17 and the 22 September dumps and nothing holds any of them yet. That makes this a tripwire rather than a hunt: the first row it returns is the first grant.

title: Which AD FS servers are still short of the July update before DKM ACL enforcement lands in October
purpose: MC1471963 turns on Enforcement mode for AD FS DKM container ACL hardening with the October 2026 Windows security update, and the prerequisite is the 14 July 2026 update or later. A server behind that build gets remediated without the audit evidence.

title: Devices still on the September rollup that the 14 September out-of-band update replaces
purpose: MC1471876 released an out-of-band update on 14 September because the 8 September rollup could stop Remote Desktop Services responding, which blocks local and remote sign-in. A device stuck on the original build is one reboot away from losing its sign-in path.

title: Apps that will break — or that quietly over-read — when User.ReadBasic.All stops returning app role assignments
purpose: MC1470871 removes app role assignments and licence details from User.ReadBasic.All, completing late September 2026. Both questions matter: which apps break, and which have been reading assignment data they were never meant to see.

title: Who now reads the saved hunting query library after ThreatHunting.Read.All widened
purpose: Table MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs, schema read from Microsoft Learn. Stored as site/kql/2026-09-18-threathunting-saved-queries-reach.kql and indexed.

title: Consent watch for the ten Graph permissions that entered the service principal on 17 September 2026
purpose: Table AuditLogs, schema read from Microsoft Learn. Stored as site/kql/2026-09-18-new-graph-scopes-consent-watch.kql and indexed.

title: Baseline authentication event listeners before onAccountTakeoverProtectionStart is used
purpose: Table MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs, schema read from Microsoft Learn. Stored as site/kql/2026-09-18-account-takeover-event-listener.kql and indexed.

title: Passkey registration events around the optimised campaign rollout
purpose: Why now. Microsoft Security Blog documented passkey-themed social engineering on 9 September, in the same fortnight the optimised registration campaign starts prompting users automatically. title: Local SYSTEM escalation attempts on domain controllers after the September update
purpose: Why now. CVE-2026-85880 gives SYSTEM from any authorised local session on Windows Server 2012 through 2022, domain controllers included. This looks for process creation running as SYSTEM whose parent is not a service host, on machines carrying the DC role.

title: Applications still reading licence and app-role data through User.ReadBasic.All
purpose: Why now. MC1470871 narrows User.ReadBasic.All this month. This finds the service principals whose recent Graph sign-ins carry that scope, so the ones that will start returning less can be identified before they quietly do.

title: Servers still exposed to the two exploited September elevation-of-privilege flaws
purpose: The only patch question that matters this weekend: which hosts still lack the September cumulative for CVE-2026-81963 and CVE-2026-85880. Table and columns verified against the Defender XDR advanced hunting schema reference.

title: Device-code and AiTM sign-ins followed by a new security-info registration
purpose: The pivot Microsoft describes for the Storm-3121 and Storm-3032 passkey-themed helpdesk campaign of 9 September: a device-code sign-in, then the operator registering their own method within two hours. Tables and columns checked on the Azure Monitor SigninLogs and AuditLogs references this morning; c

title: Custom tables that will go quiet when the HTTP Data Collector API stops on 14 September
purpose: A pipeline that stops ingesting raises no alert of its own, so measure the baseline now and compare on 15 September. Uses the union of custom tables in the workspace; run it in Log Analytics, not in advanced hunting.

title: Applications reading app role assignments or licence details on User.ReadBasic.All
purpose: MC1470871 narrows that scope from mid-September. This finds the service principals that hold it, so you can check which of them call /users/{id}/appRoleAssignments or /licenseDetails before the call starts failing. AuditLogs columns checked on the Azure Monitor reference this morning.

title: Domain controllers still missing the September 2026 cumulative update
purpose: Answers the only question that matters this morning: which Tier 0 hosts are still exposed to CVE-2026-85880. Table and columns verified on the Defender XDR advanced hunting schema reference.

title: Consent grants against a resource application that is not Microsoft Graph
purpose: A grant on Azure Data Explorer, Office 365 Management APIs or Exchange Online is invisible in a Graph permission report. This finds them in the audit log.

title: Applications still calling Exchange Web Services, by application id
purpose: Builds the EWSAllowedAppIDs list from your own telemetry instead of accepting the one Microsoft will generate. Run it over the full 60 days Microsoft says it will observe.

title: Who has been granted a permission that can delete someone else’s authentication methods
purpose: App-role grants against Microsoft Graph, filtered to the delete-credential family.

title: Is anything still calling the two APIs that stop working on 14 September
purpose: Custom-table ingestion still arriving, and SAP tables still arriving, ahead of 14 September 2026.

title: Credential deletions that are not followed by a re-registration
purpose: Authentication-method deletions with no re-registration by the same user afterwards.
